svg.aria-label: Exhibit 4: How CurWork's laptops and AWS services work together. Billers sign in through IAM Identity Center and the company sign-in, CurWork reads its settings from Parameter Store, downloads from and saves to an S3 bucket encrypted with a KMS key, and CloudTrail records every call.
svg.title: Exhibit 4: How CurWork's laptops and AWS services work together. Billers sign in through IAM Identity Center and the company sign-in, CurWork reads its settings from Parameter Store, downloads from and saves to an S3 bucket encrypted with a KMS key, and CloudTrail records every call.
svg.text: Exhibit 4: How CurWork's laptops and AWS services work together
The numbered arrows show the steps in order. Each pink box with a padlock describes a security control, and the red chips name the matching NIST SP 800-53 control.
Checks the password and the multi-factor code,
then tells IAM Identity Center who signed in.
BitLocker encrypts the disk, and the screen locks when idle.
Finish and clean up empties the work folders after each session.
Only the signed CurWork app is allowed to run.
Billers' copy of CurWork contains no admin code.
AWS Region chosen by the admin
No password or access key is
look at the rest of the bucket.
Billers can only read this folder.
logs/ holds one log per session.
Public access is blocked, and S3 accepts only TLS 1.2 or newer.
Versioning keeps every replaced copy for the retention period.
S3 checks each saved file's SHA-256 fingerprint.
FIPS endpoints can be turned on
Billers can only read the settings.
Only the AWS admin role can save
them, and every version is kept.
Keeps the CloudTrail records and alerts
when a bucket, key or access policy changes.
The biller signs in. IAM Identity Center sends the biller to the company sign-in, then gives the AWS CLI access that ends on its own.
CurWork reads the bucket, folders and rules from Parameter Store. It doesn't use S3 until it has them.
CurWork downloads the workbooks from converted/ into the In folder. The connection uses TLS 1.2 or newer.
The biller runs the Excel macros. They work on the laptop and save their results in the Out folder.
CurWork saves the results in the result folders. S3 checks each file's SHA-256 fingerprint, and CurWork checks its size.
Finish and clean up saves the session log in logs/ and then empties the In and Out folders.
The AWS admin changes the settings with the CurWork Admin Settings app. AWS refuses a save from anyone else.
CloudTrail sends its record of every call to the company's security monitoring.
A security control that protects that part.
The matching NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 control.
